notes: Squeek is a fixed-supply ERC-20 token with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SQK once to msg.sender. It has no administrative privileges or additional minting entry points. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
